description: Parameter-free rank ensemble of exposure-adjusted occupancy (max_t Cu/(Cu+Ki_t)) and intrinsic affinity (max_t -log10 Ki_t) over each liability's pre-specified receptors. Ranks are taken within the scored cohort and summed with equal weight.
rank_method: average (scipy.stats.rankdata default), within the cohort where both views are defined
fitted_on: all v2 train drugs (v2_partition()[0]); the family has no free parameter, so fitting on all train drugs leaves this file unchanged
missing_view_rule: a drug missing either view (no Cmax,u, or no measured Ki at any listed receptor) gets no score; never imputed
